name: What is the typical cost range for a bathroom vanity upgrade in the East Bay area?
description: Costs for bathroom vanity upgrades in the East Bay range from $800 for basic replacements to over $7,000 for custom, high-end options.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a bathroom vanity upgrade in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for a bathroom vanity upgrade in the East Bay area can vary widely based on materials, size, and complexity of installation. A basic replacement might start around $800-$1,500, while a custom, high-end vanity with premium materials and complex plumbing work could range from $3,000 to over $7,000. Factors like countertop material, faucet selection, and any necessary plumbing modifications will influence the final price. Given our service area in places like Berkeley and Oakland, material and labor costs can be higher than other regions.
